summary: Seerr is an open-source media request management tool that interfaces with popular home server platforms such as Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. It provides a centralised web interface where users can submit and track requests for new movies and TV shows to be added to a shared library. As a fork of Overseerr, it serves the same fundamental purpose of streamlining content curation for self-hosted media setups.
goodFor: It is well-suited for administrators of shared media servers who want to delegate content requests to family or friends via a structured approval workflow.
watchOut: Because it relies entirely on external media servers and management tools to function, it adds another layer of software to maintain and troubleshoot within your self-hosted stack.
deployNotes: It is typically deployed using Docker, which requires you to map persistent volumes for configuration data and set up a reverse proxy to handle external HTTPS traffic.
